summary: This room cuts across three neighborhoods that don't normally talk: the psychological-method entries (Identity Molting, Lateral Access, Creative Coach), the agent-infrastructure entries (Agent Toolbox, Concierge, Agent Wellbeing, Gemma 4, Enchanted Worker, Palace Enchantment), and a handful of working ledgers wearing entry frontmatter (Map Log, Curriculum Map, Claude CLI Reference). The clearest work was closing gaps the room's own entries had already named out loud: Creative Coach's repertoire table literally says "none of the three cite each other" about the narrative-therapy trio, and Palace Enchantment's own open-questions list already predicted the Palace Conatus entry that now exists and answers it — the palace had done its own homework and just hadn't wired the links back. On the newcomer side, Agent Toolbox and Gemma 4 sit in this room with near-zero inbound despite already pointing outward at Concierge, Agent Wellbeing, and Palace Enchantment with real technical citations (measured token baselines, tested register failure) — reciprocating those was a genuine two-way find, not charity. On the "cluttered" question: three files here (Map Log, Curriculum Map, Claude CLI Reference) are working data — an append-only table, a scaffolding tracker, a CLI cheat sheet — dressed as concept entries; none holds an idea, and Claude CLI Reference has already self-flagged as composting. Loudon's exhale is worth taking seriously there.
